items.excerpt_zh: Gruppo Mauro Saviola 推出全新企業介紹影片，完整呈現集團在環保板材領域的創新技術與永續發展願景。

items.content_zh:
Gruppo Mauro Saviola 推出全新企業介紹影片，完整呈現集團在環保板材領域的創新技術與永續發展願景。

作為歐洲領先的環保板材製造商，Gruppo Mauro Saviola 始終致力於推動循環經濟與永續發展。這支全新發布的企業介紹影片，帶領觀眾深入了解集團的核心價值與技術優勢。

影片重點內容：

• 集團歷史與企業願景
• 環保塑合板材生產技術
• 100% 回收木材的循環利用
• 創新的表面處理工藝
• 永續發展與環境保護承諾
• 全球市場布局與合作夥伴

Gruppo Mauro Saviola 的核心理念：

• 堅持使用 100% 回收木材作為原料
• 實踐「從搖籃到搖籃」的循環經濟模式
• 持續投入研發創新技術
• 提供高品質環保板材解決方案
• 為全球永續發展做出貢獻

作為 Gruppo Mauro Saviola 在台灣的獨家代理商，Hauboard 深感榮幸能夠與這樣具有遠見與社會責任的企業合作。透過這支企業介紹影片，我們期望讓更多台灣的客戶了解 Gruppo Mauro Saviola 的品牌價值與產品優勢，共同為環境永續發展努力。

歡迎觀看影片，深入認識這個引領歐洲環保板材產業的領導品牌。
items.content_en:
Gruppo Mauro Saviola releases a brand-new company introduction video, showcasing the group's innovative technology and sustainability vision in eco-friendly panel manufacturing.

As a leading European eco-friendly panel manufacturer, Gruppo Mauro Saviola has always been committed to promoting circular economy and sustainable development. This newly released corporate introduction video takes viewers on a journey to understand the group's core values and technological advantages.

Video Highlights:

• Company history and corporate vision
• Eco-friendly melamine chipboard production technology
• Circular utilization of 100% recycled wood
• Innovative surface treatment processes
• Sustainable development and environmental protection commitment
• Global market presence and partnerships

Gruppo Mauro Saviola's Core Philosophy:

• Committed to using 100% recycled wood as raw material
• Practicing 'cradle-to-cradle' circular economy model
• Continuous investment in R&D and innovative technology
• Providing high-quality eco-friendly panel solutions
• Contributing to global sustainable development

As the exclusive distributor of Gruppo Mauro Saviola in Taiwan, Hauboard is honored to partner with such a visionary and socially responsible enterprise. Through this corporate introduction video, we hope to help more Taiwanese customers understand Gruppo Mauro Saviola's brand value and product advantages, working together towards environmental sustainability.

We invite you to watch the video and get to know this leading brand that is shaping the European eco-friendly panel industry.

items.title_zh: 榮獲 FSC 森林認證
items.excerpt_zh: Hauboard 正式獲得 FSC 森林管理委員會認證，證明我們對永續發展的承諾。
items.excerpt_en: Hauboard has officially received FSC Forest Stewardship Council certification, demonstrating our commitment to sustainability.
items.content_zh:
Hauboard 正式獲得 FSC 森林管理委員會認證，證明我們對永續發展的承諾。

FSC（Forest Stewardship Council）森林管理委員會是一個國際性的非營利組織，致力於推動負責任的森林管理。

獲得此認證代表：

• 我們的原材料來源可追溯且合法
• 生產過程符合環境保護標準
• 支持永續森林經營
• 產品可獲得 FSC 標籤

我們將繼續堅持環保理念，為地球的永續發展貢獻心力。
items.content_en:
Hauboard has officially received FSC Forest Stewardship Council certification, demonstrating our commitment to sustainability.

FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) is an international non-profit organization dedicated to promoting responsible forest management.

This certification represents:

• Our raw materials are traceable and legally sourced
• Production processes meet environmental protection standards
• Support for sustainable forest management
• Products can obtain FSC labels

We will continue to adhere to environmental principles and contribute to the sustainable development of our planet.

items.title_zh: Gruppo Saviola 再生製造：從回收到升級利用
items.title_en: Gruppo Saviola Regenerative Manufacturing: From Recycling to Upcycling
items.excerpt_zh: Saviola Holding 透過旗下 Composad 家具部門，展現對循環經濟的承諾，專注於使用 100% 回收木材，並將廢料升級轉化為更高價值的產品。
items.excerpt_en: Saviola Holding demonstrates its commitment to circular economy through its Composad furniture division, operating exclusively with 100% recycled wood and transforming waste into higher-value products.

videos.title_zh: Saviola Holding 再生製造介紹
videos.description_zh: 深入了解 Saviola Holding 如何實踐循環經濟與升級利用理念
videos.description_en: Learn how Saviola Holding practices circular economy and upcycling principles

items.content_zh:
Saviola Holding 透過旗下 Composad 家具部門，展現對循環經濟的承諾，專注於使用 100% 回收木材，並將廢料升級轉化為更高價值的產品。

Saviola Holding 的資深董事總經理 Nicola Negri 以精闢的比喻說明公司的理念：「這不像是回收一個瓶子來製作另一個瓶子——我們拿起那個瓶子，將它升級利用，製作成一枚鑽石戒指。」

再生製造核心理念：

• 100% 使用回收木材生產
• 實踐「升級利用」而非單純回收
• 將廢棄材料轉化為更高價值產品
• 垂直整合的私營企業模式

永續發展承諾：

• 完全符合循環經濟原則
• 專注於高品質家具設計與製造
• 以環保倫理為核心的商業策略
• 展現義大利企業的永續領導地位

作為 Gruppo Mauro Saviola 在台灣的獨家代理商，Hauboard 深感榮幸能夠將這樣具有前瞻性的環保理念引進台灣市場。Saviola Holding 的再生製造模式不僅展現了技術創新，更體現了企業對地球環境的深刻承諾。

這種「升級利用」的理念超越了傳統的回收概念，透過創新技術與設計，將看似廢棄的材料轉化為具有更高價值的產品。這正是永續發展的真諦——不僅僅是減少浪費，更要創造價值。
items.content_en:
Saviola Holding demonstrates its commitment to circular economy through its Composad furniture division, operating exclusively with 100% recycled wood and transforming waste into higher-value products.

Nicola Negri, Senior Managing Director at Saviola Holding, explains the company's approach with an insightful analogy: "It's not like recycling a bottle to make another bottle – we take that bottle, and we upcycle it to make a ring of diamonds."

Core Principles of Regenerative Manufacturing:

• 100% recycled wood production
• Practicing 'upcycling' rather than simple recycling
• Transforming waste materials into higher-value products
• Vertically integrated private enterprise model

Sustainability Commitment:

• Fully aligned with circular economy principles
• Focus on quality furniture design and manufacturing
• Business strategy centered on eco-ethical values
• Demonstrating Italian leadership in sustainability

As the exclusive distributor of Gruppo Mauro Saviola in Taiwan, Hauboard is honored to bring such forward-thinking environmental concepts to the Taiwan market. Saviola Holding's regenerative manufacturing model not only demonstrates technical innovation but also reflects a profound corporate commitment to environmental stewardship.

This 'upcycling' philosophy transcends traditional recycling concepts. Through innovative technology and design, seemingly discarded materials are transformed into products of higher value. This is the true essence of sustainable development – not merely reducing waste, but creating value.

items.title_zh: Composad 進軍美國組裝家具市場
items.title_en: Composad Ready to Break Into U.S. RTA Market
items.excerpt_zh: 義大利組裝家具製造商 Composad 作為 Saviola Holding 旗下企業，正式進軍美國即裝家具市場，展現義式設計與品質優勢。
items.excerpt_en: Italian ready-to-assemble furniture manufacturer Composad, part of Saviola Holding, is making its entry into the U.S. RTA market with Italian design and quality excellence.
items.content_zh:
義大利組裝家具製造商 Composad 作為 Saviola Holding 旗下企業，正式進軍美國即裝家具市場，展現義式設計與品質優勢。

Composad 位於義大利 Viadana（米蘭南方約兩小時車程），是一家專業的組裝式家具製造商。作為 Saviola Holding 集團的一員，Composad 將義大利的設計美學與 Gruppo Mauro Saviola 的環保板材技術完美結合，為美國市場帶來獨特的產品優勢。

產品系列包括：

• 主臥室與青少年臥室系列
• 廚房家具系列
• 休閒家具系列
• 居家辦公解決方案

市場定位與優勢：

• 義大利當代設計美學
• 高品質環保板材應用
• 具競爭力的價格定位
• 完整的組裝式家具解決方案

作為 Gruppo Mauro Saviola 在台灣的獨家代理商，Hauboard 密切關注集團的全球發展動態。Composad 進軍美國市場的成功經驗，展現了 Saviola Holding 集團在全球家具產業的影響力，以及義大利製造與環保板材技術的完美結合。

這項市場擴展計畫不僅體現了集團的國際化戰略，更證明了高品質環保板材在全球市場的競爭優勢。我們期待將這些國際經驗與創新理念持續引進台灣市場。
items.content_en:
Italian ready-to-assemble furniture manufacturer Composad, part of Saviola Holding, is making its entry into the U.S. RTA market with Italian design and quality excellence.

Composad, based in Viadana (approximately two hours south of Milan), is a specialized ready-to-assemble furniture manufacturer. As a member of the Saviola Holding group, Composad perfectly combines Italian design aesthetics with Gruppo Mauro Saviola's eco-friendly panel technology, bringing unique product advantages to the U.S. market.

Product Range:

• Master and youth bedroom collections
• Kitchen furniture series
• Occasional furniture pieces
• Home office solutions

Market Positioning & Advantages:

• Contemporary Italian design aesthetics
• High-quality eco-friendly panel applications
• Competitive pricing strategy
• Comprehensive ready-to-assemble furniture solutions

As the exclusive distributor of Gruppo Mauro Saviola in Taiwan, Hauboard closely follows the group's global development. Composad's successful entry into the U.S. market demonstrates Saviola Holding's influence in the global furniture industry and the perfect integration of Italian manufacturing with eco-friendly panel technology.

This market expansion initiative not only reflects the group's internationalization strategy but also proves the competitive advantage of high-quality eco-friendly panels in the global market. We look forward to continuously bringing these international experiences and innovative concepts to the Taiwan market.

items.excerpt_zh: 我們的生產線已完成環保升級，減少 30% 碳排放，為地球盡一份心力。
items.excerpt_en: Our production line has completed an eco-friendly upgrade, reducing carbon emissions by 30%.
items.content_zh:
我們的生產線已完成環保升級，減少 30% 碳排放，為地球盡一份心力。

升級內容包括：

• 引進節能設備，降低能源消耗
• 優化生產流程，減少原料浪費
• 安裝廢氣處理系統
• 實施水資源回收再利用

環保成效：

• 碳排放減少 30%
• 能源消耗降低 25%
• 廢料回收率提升至 95%
• 水資源使用效率提升 40%

我們將持續投入環保設施的升級，為永續發展貢獻更多心力。
items.content_en:
Our production line has completed an eco-friendly upgrade, reducing carbon emissions by 30%.

Upgrade Contents:

• Introduced energy-saving equipment to reduce energy consumption
• Optimized production processes to reduce material waste
• Installed exhaust gas treatment systems
• Implemented water resource recycling

Environmental Results:

• 30% reduction in carbon emissions
• 25% reduction in energy consumption
• Waste recycling rate increased to 95%
• 40% improvement in water resource efficiency

We will continue to invest in environmental facility upgrades and contribute more to sustainable development.

items.title_zh: Gruppo Mauro Saviola 參展米蘭設計週 2018
items.title_en: Gruppo Mauro Saviola at Milano Design Week 2018
items.excerpt_zh: 我們的合作夥伴 Gruppo Mauro Saviola 於 2018 年米蘭設計週展示創新板材解決方案，展現永續設計與卓越品質。
items.excerpt_en: Our partner Gruppo Mauro Saviola showcased innovative panel solutions at Milano Design Week 2018, demonstrating sustainable design and exceptional quality.
items.content_zh:
我們的合作夥伴 Gruppo Mauro Saviola 於 2018 年米蘭設計週展示創新板材解決方案，展現永續設計與卓越品質。

米蘭設計週（Milano Design Week）是全球最重要的設計盛會之一，每年吸引來自世界各地的設計師、建築師與業界專業人士。Gruppo Mauro Saviola 作為歐洲領先的環保板材製造商，在此次展會中展示了最新的產品創新與設計理念。

展會亮點：

• 展示最新環保塑合板材系列
• 呈現創新的表面處理技術
• 分享永續生產與循環經濟理念
• 展現多樣化的設計應用案例

作為 Gruppo Mauro Saviola 在台灣的獨家代理商，Hauboard 致力於將這些創新產品與永續理念引進台灣市場。我們相信，透過選用環保材質與創新設計，可以為客戶創造更美好的生活空間，同時為地球環境盡一份心力。

米蘭設計週不僅是展示產品的平台，更是探索未來設計趨勢與建立國際合作的重要場合。Gruppo Mauro Saviola 持續參與這項國際盛會，展現其在環保板材領域的領導地位與創新能量。
items.content_en:
Our partner Gruppo Mauro Saviola showcased innovative panel solutions at Milano Design Week 2018, demonstrating sustainable design and exceptional quality.

Milano Design Week is one of the world's most important design events, attracting designers, architects, and industry professionals from around the globe each year. As a leading European eco-friendly panel manufacturer, Gruppo Mauro Saviola presented their latest product innovations and design concepts at this prestigious event.

Event Highlights:

• Showcased the latest eco-friendly melamine chipboard series
• Presented innovative surface treatment technologies
• Shared sustainable production and circular economy concepts
• Demonstrated diverse design application cases

As the exclusive distributor of Gruppo Mauro Saviola in Taiwan, Hauboard is committed to bringing these innovative products and sustainable concepts to the Taiwan market. We believe that by choosing eco-friendly materials and innovative designs, we can create better living spaces for our customers while contributing to environmental protection.

Milano Design Week is not only a platform for product showcasing but also an important occasion for exploring future design trends and establishing international collaborations. Gruppo Mauro Saviola's continued participation in this international event demonstrates its leadership and innovative energy in the eco-friendly panel industry.
